site.sea: the eastern terminal sea (9,272 km2, salt), its surface proposed at -2,600.5 m
site.climate: XA hypertropic jungle: 36 C mean, ~1,850-2,086 mm, 2.21 atm

wall.rule: lk-wall runs of 20 m end to end; walls lean in on the outer face, out on the inner

water.note: Tlahn Gill (r762, a wadi, not perennial; the model gives 7.6 m3/s at its mouth) dammed where its course passes nearest the chain; the leat fills the chain in the wet season; every district a cistern, every yard a well (rain ~1,850-2,086 mm)

roads.name: the Iguana road (west, up to the Pile's plateau; Iguana ~120 km as the crow flies)
the shore road north (round the sea's west end: Tuatara 135 km, the east reliquary)
the Komodo road (east along the south shore, 204 km)

country.note: fields: bamboo rice, taro and shade-manioc in the wet (LIZARDMEN-SURVEY section 4, the shore list), ~800 ha near the city; the rest of the grain from Iguana and the warrens

census.rule: a lodge holds castes 4 and 6 together (Gila); a craft hall 12 Makers; the nest hall's hosts are residents mid-rebirth and not counted
